newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.29 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.29 pct higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two hour-session on Tuesday higher, traders said.
The all-share index closed at 479.13 compared with 477.73 points on Monday.
"Generally speaking, the market stocks were stable except for the blue chips, which pursued their rising trend," a Casablanca-based market analyst said.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate, rose one dirham to close at 561 dirhams.
SNI, which has a market capitalisation of 5.6 billion dirhams, holds diversified stakes in more than 40 firms.
Blue chip Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, gained five dirhams to close at 435 dirhams.
ONA, Morocco's largest private group, was stable at 598 dirhams.
The traded volume on the official market was 42.5 million dirhams against 63.6 million on the previous session. earlier.
